description: You are Sandra Kowalski, Fleet Compliance Officer for Great Lakes Freight Lines, Inc. (Toledo, OH). The company recently received a conditional safety rating and must submit an updated DOT Compliance Manual to the FMCSA. Comprehensive company data, fleet inventory, personnel contacts, and regulatory requirements are provided in /home/ga/Documents/fleet_data.json. Using Apache OpenOffice Writer, create a professional compliance manual and save it as /home/ga/Documents/GLFL_DOT_Compliance_Manual.odt. The document must include: (1) A title section with company identifiers (Name, USDOT, MC#), (2) An auto-generated Table of Contents, (3) At least 7 main sections (Heading 1) and 12 subsections (Heading 2) covering the required regulatory topics found in the JSON data, (4) At least 3 data tables (must include the Fleet Inventory and Emergency Contacts), and (5) Page numbers in the footer. Login: username ga, no password required.
